title: The Jackson Heart Study of Cardiovascular Disease Among African Americans
brief_summary: This is a prospective study of the environmental and genetic factors that influence the development of cardiovascular disease (CVD) in African American adults. The cohort is a collaboration among multiple institutions (Jackson State University, Mississippi State Department of Health, Tougaloo College, and the University of Mississippi Medical Center), NIMHD, and NHLBI.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* African American
* Residents of Jackson, Mississippi

Exclusion Criteria:

* Institutionalization
study_population: African-American adult residents of metropolitan Jackson, Mississippi
